links.outcome: Lesion detection F1-score in-domain versus out-of-domain (new data source)
links.effect: F1-score of 0.64 in domain and 0.5 out of domain, a drop in performance on out-of-distribution data.
links.quote: We evaluated model generalization through out-of-distribution testing, demonstrating promising lesion detection capabilities with an F1-score of 0.64 and 0.5 in and out of the domain, respectively.

unlisted_practices: Expert questionnaire to assess clinical value of segmentation model predictions
Analysis of internal model features and error types for model interpretability

screen.reason: Empirical multicenter evaluation of deep learning models for cortical lesion segmentation on MRI scans, incorporating out-of-distribution validation, error analysis, and expert questionnaire assessment.
